rationale: Discrete enumeration over dispatch_step grids (ev_a in {-4,0,4,8}, ev_b in {-3,0,3,6}). Each EV can supply at most 6.0 kWh from its usable energy above reserve (8 kWh usable * 0.9 discharge efficiency, quantized to the 4/3 kW steps within power limits), so 12.0 kWh is the maximum critical-load energy servable. The schedule (4,4,4) and (6,3,3) keeps per-interval dispatch within each load and avoids curtailment. Final SOC leaves both EVs above reserve.
